summary.text: John Holm is the Democratic candidate for the Oregon House of Representatives, District 6, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Kim Wallan (R). He advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026, and works as a political consultant.

paragraphs.text: Holm graduated from Hidden Valley High School and lists political consulting as his career experience.
He ran in the 2020 Democratic primary for Oregon's 2nd Congressional District, where he received 8.1 percent of the vote in a field won by Alex Spenser.
In the 2024 Democratic primary for Oregon House District 6, Holm received 8.0 percent of the vote and lost to Lilia Caballero, who went on to lose the general election to Wallan.
